title: Graphene's role in enhancing Fe3O4 nanofibers: a comparative exploration of room temperature impedance characteristics and EMI shielding performance
content:
RSC Adv., 2025, 15,16098-16109
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA00006H, Paper

Ujala Anwar, Sonia Kiran, Roya Feroze, N. A. Noor, Sadia Nazir, Sohail Mumtaz, Ihab Mohamed Moussa
X-ray diffraction (XRD) pattern confirms that the spinel structure of pure Fe3O4 is retained in Fe3O4 and Fe3O4-Gr nanofibers. For both nanofibers, impedance spectroscopy showed a single semicircular response, indicating bulk relaxation processes.
